Name: GPoseStudio
Author: Mysterious Popoto
Description: Captures the GPose frame and applies GPoseStudio color/lighting looks. Cosmetic, client-side only. Works alongside Brio/Ktisis.
Changelog:
0.9.8 - Orbs: eight shapes including a bladed aperture from three leaves to twelve, their own colour and a spread across it, and a mode needing neither a highlight nor depth. Particles and orbs are still in progress and are not in this build yet.
0.9.7 - Particles sit in the air rather than on the glass: three layers at different focus, sprites that tumble as they fall, and a Solid mode so ash stops glowing. Bokeh needs a highlight to exist, and has a cat's eye. Freeze stops the clock so a still can be composed.
0.9.6 - Snowfall and Ashfall pulled back so the place you are shooting in still shows through them. A new option clears every setting before a look is applied, for the looks that do not mention everything: a saved part, or a file written before half these settings existed.
0.9.5 - Text captions appear in the exported image. They never did: they were an overlay drawn on the game, and the file comes from the GPU, so a caption showed while you posed and was gone from every picture. One rasteriser now feeds both, so the preview is what gets saved. Multiple lines, any installed font, a real outline, and a size that no longer changes with export scale.
0.9.4 - The built-in set rebuilt: 14 looks designed as a set rather than accumulated one at a time, across Portrait, Cinematic, Backdrop, Weather and Stylised. The 26 earlier looks are kept and installable, and never overwritten. The Looks tab is reorganised around the list rather than around the machinery.
